Contribution to Workshop on Software Engineering for Embedded Systems

A paper entitled "Maintenance of Embedded Systems: Supporting Program Comprehension Using Dynamic Analysis" by Jonas Trümper, Stefan Voigt, and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 2nd International Workshop on Software Engineering for Embedded Systems (SEES), which will be held in Zurich, Switzerland, on June 9th 2012.
